You are implementing frontend fixes in a Tauri v2 desktop app at /Users/egortokarev/Code/voxfusion/packages/app. The frontend is **SolidJS** (not React — this matters: several bugs you're fixing are React idioms that are no-ops in Solid). First read /Users/egortokarev/Code/voxfusion/IMPROVEMENTS.md sections "B. Desktop app — frontend" and "C. Product UX" for context.

You own these files ONLY (another agent concurrently owns the Dictionary*/Style* pages and a third owns all Rust code — do not touch those): src/pages/VoiceControl.tsx, src/pages/Home.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/components/UpdateNotification.tsx, src/components/SettingsModal.tsx, src/components/TranscriptionList.tsx, src/components/settings/ModelSettings.tsx, src/components/onboarding/steps/ModelDownloadStep.tsx, src/components/onboarding/steps/MicrophonePermissionStep.tsx, src/components/onboarding/steps/AccessibilityPermissionStep.tsx, src/lib/commands/* (read; extend if needed), src/i18n/translations/*.ts (all 7 locales — you own i18n edits in this wave). Do not commit.

**Rust contract (a parallel agent is implementing this right now — code against it, don't read models.rs/audio.rs expecting it to exist yet):**
- Event `recording-error`, payload `{ message: string }` — emitted when the mic stream dies mid-recording; the Rust side also clears its recording state.
- Event `model-download-progress`, payload `{ modelId: string, progress: number /*0-100*/, downloadedBytes: number, totalBytes: number }` (replaces whatever the payload was before).
- New command `cancel_model_download` invoked as `invoke("cancel_model_download", { modelId })`. Cancelling keeps the partial file; a later download resumes from it.
- `download_model` now errors with "download already in progress" on duplicate calls, and resumes partial downloads automatically.

Implement:

1. **Dictation failures visible (VoiceControl.tsx)**:
   - `:311-314` — on transcription error: instead of log-and-hide, show an error state in the overlay pill (compact red/error styling consistent with the pill design) with the localized message and a Retry affordance that re-invokes transcription with the preserved WAV path (the path is in scope from the stop call); auto-hide after ~5s if untouched. Keep Escape/cancel working.
   - `:410-417` — on recording-start failure: show the same error pill state briefly (~4s) instead of silently hiding.
   - Listen for the new `recording-error` event: transition the pill to the error state and reset local recording UI state so the next hotkey press works.
   - `:325` — check the `typeText` Result: on failure, invoke the existing accessibility probe command (grep src/lib/commands and src-tauri/src/lib.rs for its name — something like check_accessibility_probe) and if permission is missing, `emit("accessibility-permission-needed")` (App.tsx:150-154 already listens for this cross-window; read that handler to confirm what it does and make sure the flow makes sense end-to-end).
2. **Solid lifecycle bugs (one pattern, six sites)** — use the correct pattern that already exists in UpdateNotification.tsx:64-80 (hoisted unlisten var + disposed flag + synchronous onCleanup):
   - SettingsModal.tsx:81-92 — `createEffect` returning a "cleanup" (never runs in Solid; keydown listeners accumulate every open). Use onCleanup.
   - ModelSettings.tsx:35-46 — onCleanup after await in async onMount never runs; listener leaks per Model-section open.
   - ModelDownloadStep.tsx:33-41 — same.
   - TranscriptionList.tsx:100-103,129-132 — unlisten assigned after await; leak on fast unmount.
   - AccessibilityPermissionStep.tsx:80-82 — same.
   - App.tsx:139,148,154,164 — four onCleanups after awaits (no-ops); restructure to synchronous onCleanup.
3. **Update notification (UpdateNotification.tsx)**: fix the progress math (`:103-105,152` currently accumulates raw bytes and renders bytes/10 as a % — capture `contentLength` on the Started event, accumulate downloaded bytes, render `downloaded/contentLength*100`, show MB figures); render the release notes from `update()?.body` (scrollable, modest height) — the i18n key `update.newVersion` exists unused; add a dismiss button using the unused `update.ignore` key so the banner can be closed for the session.
4. **Download UX (ModelDownloadStep.tsx + ModelSettings.tsx)**: consume the new progress payload — show MB downloaded / total MB, transfer speed (compute from byte deltas between events), and ETA; add a Cancel button wired to `cancel_model_download`; on retry after failure/cancel, note the download resumes (backend handles it — just don't reset the visual progress to 0 until the first new event arrives). Surface errors with a translated generic message + the raw error as secondary detail.
5. **Mic-permission dead-end (MicrophonePermissionStep.tsx:35-51)**: when `getUserMedia` fails with a permanent denial (NotAllowedError), stop showing a retry that can never work — show explanatory text and an "Open System Settings" button that opens `x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_Microphone` (use the same opener mechanism AccessibilityPermissionStep uses — read it), and keep polling/retrying so the step auto-advances once granted.
6. **Home hotkey hint (Home.tsx:25, TranscriptionList.tsx:158)**: en.ts:219 and en.ts:292-293 hardcode "Left Control+Left Option" in the copy. Convert those strings (in ALL 7 locales) to use a `{{hotkey}}` template placeholder and interpolate `hotkeyDisplayName(settings().hotkey)` at the call sites (the i18n `t()` already supports templates via resolveTemplate — see src/i18n/index.ts:40; LearningStep.tsx:36 shows how hotkeyDisplayName is used).
7. **i18n for everything you added**: every new user-visible string goes through the i18n system with keys added to ALL 7 locale files (en, de, es, fr, it, ru, zh) with real translations (you are multilingual — translate properly, matching each file's existing tone/casing conventions).

Constraints: match existing code style; SolidJS idioms only; run `bunx biome check --write <changed files>` (only your files, never repo-wide); finish with `bun run --filter @voxfusion/app typecheck` and make it pass (if it fails due to the OTHER agent's in-flight Dictionary/Style changes, say so and confirm your files are clean via `bunx tsc --noEmit` scoped reasoning). Your final message: what changed per file, any deviations from the Rust contract you had to make, typecheck result.

## B. Desktop app — frontend (SolidJS)

Framework confirmed **SolidJS** (README is correct). Several bugs below are React idioms that silently do nothing in Solid.

### High
- **B1 (H)** `VoiceControl.tsx:100,309` — overlay window never runs `initSettings()`; always transcribes with `"default"` style (see Top #4).
- **B2 (H)** `SettingsModal.tsx:81-92` — `createEffect` "returning a cleanup" is a React-ism; the cleanup never runs, so every modal open adds a permanent window keydown listener and Escape fires `onClose` even when closed. Use `onCleanup`.
- **B3 (H)** `ModelSettings.tsx:35-46` — `onCleanup` after `await` in async `onMount` runs outside the reactive owner → `model-download-progress` listener leaks on every Model-section open, mutating disposed signals. Register synchronous `onCleanup` + `disposed` flag (correct pattern exists in `UpdateNotification.tsx:64-80`).
- **B4 (H)** `ModelDownloadStep.tsx:33-41` — same bug: listener leaks each time step 5 mounts.
- **B5 (H)** `UpdateNotification.tsx:104,152` — progress bar accumulates raw bytes, renders `bytes/10 %` (see Top #13).

### Medium — correctness
- **B6 (M)** `OnboardingWizard.tsx:32-57` — no `isAnimating()` guard on Next/Back; double-click skips a step and bypasses `canProceed()` permission gating.
- **B7 (M)** `VoiceControl.tsx:207-250` + `hotkeyUtils.ts:309-331` — concurrent hotkey re-registration has no mutex; interleaving leaks registrations so one keypress fires two handlers (instant start+stop). Serialize through a promise chain.
- **B8 (M)** `TranscriptionList.tsx:100-103,129-132` and `AccessibilityPermissionStep.tsx:80-82` — `unlisten` assigned after `await listen(...)`; unmount before resolve leaks the listener into a disposed component.
- **B9 (M)** `App.tsx:139,148,154,164` — four no-op `onCleanup`s after awaits (harmless only because App never unmounts; breaks HMR and invites copy-paste bugs — B3/B4 are that bug).
- **B10 (M)** `useHotkeyRecorder.ts:175-181` — failed hotkey save returns false without `setError`; recorder hangs in recording mode with no feedback.
- **B11 (M)** `settingsStore.ts:197-204` — `updateLanguage` is the only updater that doesn't emit `settings-changed`.
- **B12 (M)** Locale double-persisted: localStorage is the only read path (`i18n/index.ts:63-73`), Tauri-store `language` is write-only. Clearing localStorage reverts UI to English. Single-source it.
- **B13 (M)** `VoiceControl.tsx:291-314` — stop/transcribe failures swallowed (see Top #2).
- **B14 (M)** All Dictionary/Style pages swallow fetch/add errors (`DictionaryDefault.tsx:21-24,36-42`, `DictionarySites.tsx:30-36`, `DictionaryPerApp.tsx:39-42`, `StylePerApp.tsx:32-35,125`, `StylePerSite.tsx:22-28,42`). Shared error signal + inline banner.
- **B15 (M)** `TranscriptionList.tsx:100-103` — every `transcription-created` event resets pagination to page 1 mid-scroll. Prepend/merge by id instead.
- **B16 (M)** `DictionaryDefault.tsx:116-128` — empty state flashes before first fetch resolves (sibling pages gate on `loading()`; this one doesn't).
- **B17 (M)** `SettingsModal.tsx:100-171` — no `role="dialog"`, no `aria-modal`, no focus trap/restore; close button unlabeled.
- **B18 (M)** `TranscriptionCard.tsx:66-77` — copy button only exists in DOM while hovered; keyboard users can never reach it. Render always, reveal via CSS.
- **B19 (M)** Three dropdowns with zero/divergent keyboard + ARIA support (`settings/Select.tsx`, `StyleSelect.tsx`, inline clone in `MicrophoneStep.tsx:19-84`). One accessible component.
- **B20 (M)** `AddSiteForm.tsx:53-58` — input cleared before `onAdd` resolves; combined with B14 a failed add wipes input with no feedback.

### Medium — i18n
- **B21 (M)** Hold-to-speak strings shipped in English in all 6 non-English locales (`ru.ts:49,164,186-189,216-217` + equivalents in es/zh/de/fr/it; scattered extras: fr `sidebar.style`, it `sidebar.home`, de `update.newVersion`). Key sets are complete — values just untranslated.
- **B22 (M)** ~30 user-visible hardcoded English strings bypass i18n while their keys exist unused: theme labels (`AppearanceSettings.tsx:12-22` vs unused `settings.light/dark/system`), `HotkeySettings.tsx` labels, `AudioSettings.tsx:61,67`, `SettingsModal.tsx:26-32,166`, list empty/error states (`TranscriptionList.tsx:144-157`, all Dictionary/Style pages), onboarding `[STEP_0X]` headers, `[EDIT]/[DEL]/[SAVE]/[CANCEL]` buttons, aria-labels (`VoiceControl.tsx:448,470`, `DotMatrixSpinner.tsx:35`), validation errors (`hotkeyUtils.ts:368,378`, `useHotkeyRecorder.ts:300,308`). Also `LanguageSettings.tsx:14` — "RUSSIAN" in English while others use native names.
- **B23 (M)** ~49 dead i18n keys × 7 locales ≈ 350 lines of dead weight (full list in audit; several correspond exactly to the hardcoded strings above — wire them up).
- **B24 (M)** Manual `.replace("{count}", …)` in 6 call sites while `resolveTemplate` is already wired into `t()`.

### Medium — duplication (~500 removable lines)
- **B25 (M)** `DictionaryPerApp.tsx` (536) vs `DictionarySites.tsx` (338) are ~70% clones; `DictionaryDefault.tsx:130-195` repeats the editable-word-row a third time. Extract `<WordListEditor>` (~350 lines saved).
- **B26 (M)** App-search combobox + `AppRowSkeleton` + `AppIcon` duplicated verbatim between `StylePerApp.tsx` and `DictionaryPerApp.tsx` (~160 lines × 2). Extract `<AppSearchCombobox>`.
- **B27 (M)** Three dropdown implementations (see B19) — consolidate.
- **B28 (M)** `styleLabel` switch duplicated 3× (`StyleDefault.tsx:20-31`, `StylePerApp.tsx:146-157`, `StylePerSite.tsx:61-72`).

### Performance
- **B35 (M)** `VoiceControl.tsx:186` — 1 s reposition poll runs forever, 2 IPC calls/sec even while hidden (battery). Reposition on show instead.
- **B36 (M)** `commands/apps.ts:42-58` — `installedAppsCache` never invalidated; newly installed apps invisible until restart.
- **B37 (M)** `settingsStore.ts:67-82` — 9 sequential store round-trips per `loadSettings`, re-run in full on every `settings-changed` in VoiceControl.
- **B38 (M)** `TranscriptionList.tsx` — unbounded DOM growth (no virtualization) + O(n²) group rebuild + `getDateLabel` omits year.
- **B39 (M)** `favicons.ts:4` — favicons fetched from Google (leaks configured site domains) and eagerly preloaded at every launch (`App.tsx:114-123`); `index.html`/`voice-control.html` load Inter from Google Fonts at runtime (network dependency in a desktop app, blank fonts offline). Proxy/cache favicons; bundle the font.

### Low
- **B40 (L)** `HotkeySettings.tsx:41-44,78-81` — a stale validation error on one recorder disables the *other* recorder's Change button. Key on `isRecording` only.
- **B41 (L)** `autofocus` on dynamically-inserted edit inputs unreliable in WKWebView (`DictionaryDefault.tsx:145`, `DictionaryPerApp.tsx:433`, `DictionarySites.tsx:278`). Use ref + `.focus()`.
- **B42 (L)** Unhandled rejections: `SettingsModal.tsx:64,77`, `TranscriptionCard.tsx:25`, `OnboardingWizard.tsx:41,54`, module-level calls in `voice-control.tsx:21-26`.
- **B43 (L)** Un-cleared timeouts firing on disposed components: `TranscriptionCard.tsx:31`, `SettingsModal.tsx:66`, `LearningStep.tsx:60-63`.
- **B44 (L)** `settingsStore.ts:109-113,169` — `saveBrowserValue` Result silently dropped (theme FOUC mirror can silently stop updating).
- **B45 (L)** `settingsStore.ts:44-65` — `getStore()` caches the resolved value, not the promise; concurrent init double-loads.
- **B46 (L)** `settingsStore.ts:238-243` — onboarding uses explicit `save()`, everything else relies on `autoSave: 500` (quit within 500 ms loses changes). Pick one.
- **B47 (L)** `posthog.ts:5,27` — hardcoded key with a dead `if (!POSTHOG_KEY)` guard; no opt-out (see Top #6).
- **B48 (L)** `VoiceControl.tsx:443` — `align-center` isn't a Tailwind class (meant `items-center`).
- **B49 (L)** `tailwind.config.js` — `primary`/`midnight`/`accent` palettes (~40 lines) have zero usages.
- **B50 (L)** `hotkeyUtils.ts:353-360` — `"CommandOrControl"` renders as `"⌘Or⌃"`.
- **B51 (L)** `DictionaryPerApp.tsx:37` / `StylePerApp.tsx:30` — `optionRefs` Map never pruned as filters shrink.

- **C8 (M)** Home hotkey hint hardcoded to the default hotkey (see Quick wins).
- **C9 (M)** Accessibility onboarding step force-marks granted after 4 failed probes because the distributed notification fires for *any* app's AX toggle (`AccessibilityPermissionStep.tsx:61-68`) — defers failure to a silent typing error later.

- **C13 (M)** Model download state is component-local: closing Settings or navigating the wizard shows "Download" again while a download streams (also corruption risk, A17). Backend-derived state.

- **C14 (L)** Tray mic submenu empty until any settings change (`tray.rs:48` builds with `vec![]`).
- **C15 (L)** No recording indicator in the tray — the icon is static; the pill is the only ambient mic-live signal.
- **C16 (L)** History: copy-only — no delete, no search, no full-text expand (truncated at 150 chars). Sensitive history can't be removed.
- **C17 (L)** Dictionary/Style: no bulk add, import/export anywhere — words entered one at a time; no backup/migration path.

**Verified good:** onboarding progress persists per-step across quits; Back navigation exists; deleted/corrupt model auto-resumes onboarding at the download step; settings save immediately and say so; diagnostics are metadata-only into a 5 MB-capped local log; updates are opt-in, never forced.

All done. Everything checks out — biome clean, typecheck exit 0. Final report:

## What changed per file

**src/lib/commands/model.ts** — `ModelDownloadProgress` updated to the landed contract (`{ modelId, progress, downloadedBytes, totalBytes }`, camelCase); added `cancelModelDownload(modelId)` invoking `cancel_model_download`.

**src/pages/VoiceControl.tsx** — the big one:
- New error-pill state (compact, `border-ac`/`text-ac` red-accent styling matching the pill; 260px window width). Transcription failure shows a localized message + Retry button that re-runs the extracted `transcribeAndType(filePath, bundleId, domain)` with the preserved WAV path/app context; auto-hides after 5s. Recording start/stop failures show a 4s error pill instead of silently hiding.
- Listens for `recording-error` `{ message }`: resets all local recording state (signals + `isStarting`/`isStopping` latches), restores media, shows the error pill — next hotkey press works.
- `typeText` Result is now checked: on failure it runs `checkAccessibilityProbe()` and, if permission is missing, `emit("accessibility-permission-needed")`, plus shows a "couldn't type text" pill (text is still saved to history).
- Escape now cancels recording *or* dismisses the error pill (same registered shortcut); starting a new recording clears any error state.
- Overlay window has no I18nProvider, so the component instantiates `createAppI18n(getStoredLocale())` directly and re-reads the locale on `settings-changed`.
- Its own async-onMount listener block rewritten to the hoisted-disposers + disposed-flag pattern (it had the same B9 bug).

**Solid lifecycle fixes (UpdateNotification pattern)**: SettingsModal.tsx (createEffect return → `onCleanup`), ModelSettings.tsx, ModelDownloadStep.tsx, TranscriptionList.tsx, AccessibilityPermissionStep.tsx (disposed flag; guard after await), App.tsx (all four post-await `onCleanup`s replaced by one synchronously-registered onCleanup draining a disposers array).

**UpdateNotification.tsx** — progress now `downloadedBytes/contentLength*100` (contentLength captured on Started), MB figures + % rendered; release notes from `update()?.body` in a scrollable `max-h-24` block; version line uses `update.newVersion`; "Ignore" dismiss button (per-session, remembers dismissed version so periodic checks don't resurface it).

**ModelSettings.tsx + ModelDownloadStep.tsx** — consume new payload; show MB/total, smoothed transfer speed (EMA over byte deltas), ETA (`m:ss`/`h:mm:ss`); Cancel button wired to `cancel_model_download`; visual progress not reset on retry (resume note shown when partial progress exists); `"download already in progress"` errors keep the progress UI instead of erroring; `"Download cancelled"` suppressed; errors render generic translated message + raw error as secondary detail; progress events arriving without a local download mark the model as downloading (survives remount mid-download).

**MicrophonePermissionStep.tsx** — `NotAllowedError` from getUserMedia (or `denied` permission state) switches to a denied state: explanatory text + "Open System Settings" button opening `x-apple.systempreferences:...?Privacy_Microphone`; polls `permissions.query` every 1s so the step auto-advances once granted.

**Home.tsx / TranscriptionList.tsx + all 7 locales** — `home.pressToRecord` and `transcriptionList.useCommandToRecord` converted to `{{hotkey}}` templates, interpolated with `hotkeyDisplayName(settings().hotkey)`.

**i18n (en/de/es/fr/it/ru/zh)** — new keys with real translations: `voiceControl.{transcriptionFailed,recordingFailed,typingFailed,retry}`, `settings.{modelDownloadedOfTotal,modelDownloadSpeed,modelEta,modelResumeNote}`, `onboarding.micPermissionDenied`; `Translations` type updated.
